0.0: Sigh, what can I do? Is there no one who can rid the world of this evil? No... If evil exists in the world, then that means good must also exist. There must be someone who can oppose this evil. That person is...you!\r\n#L0##b(Huh? What?! What is this guy talking about?)#l\n#k
0.1: Yes, you have been chosen to protect us from the threat of the mighty #o8144005#! I have fasted many years to learn such discernment, and though I'm very hungry, I know for sure you are the one! Go now, and end the threat of the #o8144005#! \r\n#L0##b(But why me...? Argh... I guess I'll have to do it.)#l\n#k
0.2: Ha! I knew you would believe.

yes.0: To end the threat of the #o8144005#, defeat 100 of them and bring me #b50#k of their #bAxes#k. Without weapons, they cannot harm us. GO! I await your return!
yes.1: Just in case you're unaware, #b#p9000075##k knows the way to the Red Goblin Caves. Talk to him and he will send you there.

no.0: You still don't seem to understand your true mission. Meditate, and you shall find the path you must travel...

1.0: Ah, you have diminished the threat of the #o8144005# and brought me a trophy of your work. I knew you were the chosen one!

yes.0: But is the threat of the #o8144005# at an end? NOT EVEN CLOSE! I foresee that they will rise again in an #bhour#k, and another chosen hero will fall into my lap!
